# [CS017] GraphQL Introspection Enabled Unconditionally (graphql-introspection-enabled)

GraphQL introspection is enabled in every environment.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | LOW |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-200](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/200.html) |
| **OWASP** | A02:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Introspection publishes the full schema, including internal and admin-only fields, which helps attackers find unprotected operations. Enable it only in development.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
srv := handler.New(es)
srv.Use(extension.Introspection{})
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
srv := handler.New(es)
if cfg.Environment == "development" {
	srv.Use(extension.Introspection{})
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [graphql-introspection-enabled]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    graphql-introspection-enabled: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore graphql-introspection-enabled -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** graphql-introspection-enabled
```
